question: How do I bookmark a story?
answer: Sign in, open any story and select the bookmark icon. Your saved items appear in My collection and on your dashboard.

question: Can I buy merchandise here?
answer: No. Fan Hub Plus is a merchandise showcase only. There is no checkout, payment gateway or order processing.

question: How do I submit my own fan story?
answer: Sign in and open Submit a fan story. An administrator reviews every submission before it is published in Explore.

question: How do I find events near me?
answer: Open Events and choose Use my location, or filter by city. Your coordinates stay in the browser and are never saved.

question: How do I switch to dark mode or larger text?
answer: Use the theme button in the header, or set appearance and text size on your profile page.
